SwitchPreference.app:title: Enable flexible workspace
SwitchPreference.app:summary: Use resizable launcher panes instead of one fixed full-screen content area

SeekBarPreference.app:title: First pane size (%)
SeekBarPreference.app:summary: Initial size of the first pane; the divider can also be dragged directly on the launcher

SwitchPreference.app:title: Resizable divider
SwitchPreference.app:summary: Drag the divider continuously between 15% and 85%; when disabled the divider is completely hidden

SwitchPreference.app:title: Long-press empty space to add widgets
SwitchPreference.app:summary: Any empty workspace surface can open the existing KISS widget picker

SwitchPreference.app:title: KISS gestures on empty panes
SwitchPreference.app:summary: Keep configured KISS swipe gestures active on empty workspace surfaces

SwitchPreference.app:title: Free widget resizing
SwitchPreference.app:summary: Drag a widget's lower-right corner to resize its width and height within the pane and provider limits

Preference.app:title: Pane architecture
Preference.app:summary: Apps & history and Android widgets can occupy either pane. The workspace foundation is designed for more Smart S panels and widgets later.
